author: FazeOfKnight1
body: It's honestly so fun. It requires timing; teamwork; cool mlg pvp skills. It's a general fun pack; my new favourite out of everything. Basically to y'all who don't know what it is; you have a kit and you run to the hill. at random timing, the hill will decide to give out points, and whoever on the hill is rewarded points to their team. first to 200 wins. My previous match, I had a blast. Everyone else had a team of 4 or 3, and our team, Yellow decreased to me and another guy. We thought we would lose; but no. We worked well. We waited for the timer. We won by a margin of 40 points. 2v4. I'm so proud of us. More people should play on it around my timezone(Australia). It's just so good.
